Preserve Pages order/nesting/expansion, direct/chat tab paths, favorites, chat parents/drafts and unrelated opaque fields.

Prove projected organization against disposable native Paper and clean restart; no authority switch or legacy editor retirement.

Nested human Pages, same-slug cloud destinations, favorites and chat paths map without changing unrelated data.
Ambiguous closed-target records, malformed navigation and foreign/missing identities block rather than guessing.
Native navigation/restart, meaningful unit tests, full desktop/root and reviewed screenshot/motion evidence pass.
nextAction: Implement a non-mutating offline workspace projection with strict typed-destination checks, then native organization rehearsal.
